:::{#exm-complex-modulus}
#### Absolute values of complex numbers

- $$
  \begin{aligned}
  \abs{3 + 4\,i} &= \sqrt{3^2 + 4^2} \\
  &= \sqrt{25} \\
  &= 5.
  \end{aligned}
  $$

- $$
  \begin{aligned}
  \abs{-2\,i} &= \sqrt{0^2 + (-2)^2} \\
  &= \sqrt{4} \\
  &= 2.
  \end{aligned}
  $$

- For a real number $a = a + 0\,i$,

  $$
  \begin{aligned}
  \abs{a} &= \sqrt{a^2 + 0^2} \\
  &= \sqrt{a^2},
  \end{aligned}
  $$

  which is the usual absolute value of $a$;
  for instance,

  $$
  \begin{aligned}
  \abs{-3} &= \sqrt{9} \\
  &= 3.
  \end{aligned}
  $$

:::
